title: White students make up 90.7% of Thousand Islands High School population for 2025-26
text:
Thousand Islands High School enrolled 243 white students in the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 3% increase from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
Reports show the school had a total of 268 students in 2025-26, with white students representing 90.7% of the entire student body, making them the predominant ethnic group on campus.
Thousand Islands High School is part of the Thousand Islands Central School District, headquartered in Clayton.
Of the district’s four schools, Thousand Islands High School held the highest count of white student enrollment at that time.
World Population Review analysis shows that New York’s public education system ranked second in the nation overall , while it ranked 31st for K-12 performance.
